rule: Every record_level_consumed_path must be explicitly classified and validated; no silent exemption.
control_identity_exemption_rule: Exemption must carry this exact policy release ID and SHA256; absence of an explicit binding fails closed.
historical_binding_rule: Bind to governed PIT evidence through an approved evidence resolver or to an approved governed release represented by such immutable evidence.
hard_risk_gate_rule: NONE may use explicit conditional exemption; non-NONE must use governed PIT evidence consistent with existing hard-risk-gate provenance semantics.
